note: DEFEAT, baked by gen/bake/bake.cjs from gen/bake/defeat.ts (the old defeat screen src/scenes/front/defeat.ts). cause.<starved|temple|council|alone|ground>: what killed the god (pictures.ts defeatPicture), k = 3 px per unit of its 240 x 120 picture, origin its top left. spark: the god's last spark (drawSpark at size 1), additive, k = 2 px per logical px of the 1600 x 900 frame, origin its centre (the eye); the screen scales it by lerp(1, 0.55, out) and fades it. ramp.<i>: white, alpha the old radial gradient from f = i / 64 of its radius (alpha 0) to its edge (alpha 1), 1 in the corners: k = 64 px per unit of the outer radius r1, origin the centre; placed at the eye scaled to r1, the screen past its square filled solid. The drain: f = 0.55 R / (R + 260), r1 = R + 260, tinted 128 gray in a saturation blend over a uniform 0.35 d layer, then black at 0.38 d; the dark: f = 0.35 R / (R + 120), r1 = R + 120, black over a uniform d^2 layer.
